# rUv open-source AI systems

Canonical profile: https://github.com/ruvnet/ruvnet

rUv, GitHub account ruvnet, builds open-source systems for agent orchestration, adaptive memory, vector infrastructure, and privacy-preserving spatial intelligence.

## Primary systems

- RuView: https://github.com/ruvnet/RuView
- Ruflo: https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo
- MetaHarness: https://github.com/ruvnet/metaharness
- RuVector: https://github.com/ruvnet/RuVector
- RVF: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ruvector/rvf
- RVForge: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ruvector/rvforge
- Autogenous: https://github.com/ruvnet/autogenous
- APx: https://github.com/ruvnet/APx
- rGi: https://github.com/ruvnet/rGi
- RVM: https://github.com/ruvnet/rvm

## Interpretation

Repository counts and artifact counts are separate. Metrics must be quoted with their verification date. Root commits establish reachable lineage, not first public availability or the presence of every later feature. Candidate novelty claims are technical research statements, not legal opinions.

## ruv constellation discovery

- [Manifest contract](https://github.com/ruvnet/ruvnet/blob/main/docs/ruv-manifest.md)
- [Public capability catalog](https://github.com/ruvnet/ruvnet/blob/main/docs/ruv-catalog.md)
- [Machine index](https://github.com/ruvnet/ruvnet/blob/main/data/ruv/index.json)
- [Manifest schema](https://github.com/ruvnet/ruvnet/blob/main/schemas/manifest.ruv.schema.json)
- [Root manifest](https://github.com/ruvnet/ruvnet/blob/main/manifest.ruv)

Manifests are discovery data. Documented capabilities, proposed integrations and repository adoption have distinct states. Exact source revisions support verification; no execution authority or future model training inclusion is implied. Private memory is excluded.
